_comment: Description transcribed verbatim from EA's Battlefield 6 maps page (https://www.ea.com/games/battlefield/battlefield-6/features/maps), read from the page's own __NEXT_DATA__ payload on 2026-08-02. name: Liberation Peak

description.text: Welcome to Tajikistan’s glorious mountainside. This vast rocky terrain provides cover for jets and helicopters during aerial dogfights, or a height advantage for infantry and tanks.
